title: “Africa is also driving innovation,” says Tendresse Lompala, MMB Packaging
summary: Tendresse Lompala is a Congolese entrepreneur based in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Trained as a nurse and nutritionist, she is the founder and Managing Director of MMB Packaging (Mwana Mboka Tolia ya Biso), a company specialising in the design, manufacturing and customisation of packaging for food and cosmetic products. The young woman is also behind Tendrelac, a brand of nutritious cereals. Tendresse was selected for the Future Leaders Class of 2027 by Paris Packaging... - Packaging & design
